qualification: Offline scheduling checks pass; drop-to-map latency is not runtime-qualified.

rehearsal.source: docs/evidence/runtime/reh14/result.json, act1.json and final-state.json at the evidence ref
limitations: No per-job created/start/finish/attempt timestamps are recorded in these receipts.
Layout timings include presenter navigation and approval; the tray had stale event-stream responses.
Several batches ran together; the receipt records host CPU at 85% and processor health checks timing out.
Two published packages are not two raw chunks: 2100 features require 21 chunks at the unchanged cap of 100.

conclusion: There is no mandatory multi-minute sleep on the successful streamed path; 180 seconds is a recovery lease.
The 750 ms dispatcher poll and 1 s empty-source polls cannot alone establish the reported 966 s cause.
The dispatcher can waste its twelve-row window on occupied singleton operations and await unrelated long jobs.
Those scheduling barriers are removed, but their REH14 contribution is unknown, not an asserted speedup.
Serial geometry SQL, source-key writes, normalization and candidate persistence remain likely expensive work.
The streamed layout is officer-stated: it does not invoke the bounded-file teacher proposal path.

chain.operation: large-original-storage for queued finalization; intake-zip-layers for ZIP members; intake-large
chain.claimant: Dispatcher singleton per operation; upload SQL fences storage, fenced attempts own ZIP fan-out.
chain.fixedWaits: 750 ms dispatcher poll; storage lease 180 s, failure retry 10 s; no successful-path sleep.
chain.estimatedShare: At most 0.75 s per handoff (0.08% of ZIP total); transfer/hash/probe time is unallocated.

chain.operation: All non-usp: jobs; probe-first, oldest per file/lane, LIMIT 12
chain.claimant: Dispatcher selects/admit-reserves; each in-process runner claims its own fenced attempt.
chain.fixedWaits: 750 ms after a tick; occupied singletons formerly consumed the ready window indefinitely.
chain.estimatedShare: 750 ms per tick is small; queue starvation can span another job's duration, share unknown.

chain.step: start raw reader and profile together
chain.operation: intake-large enqueues streaming-vector and streamed-profile in the existing authority
chain.claimant: One intake-large runner per dispatcher; claimUspJobAttempt, then stable state-key wake-ups.
chain.fixedWaits: No sleep between enqueues; vector lane has two slots shared with reader/profile/drafting.
chain.estimatedShare: About 0-1.5 s for two idle handoffs; contention is not separable from retain-to-layout.

chain.step: raw read, geometry validation and immutable chunk publication
chain.claimant: Singleton reader claims fenced attempt; one awaited topology transaction per accepted geometry.
chain.fixedWaits: No per-feature sleep; chunks <=100 records/512 KiB; 30 s heartbeat; 180 s lease; retry 2 s.
chain.estimatedShare: Combined read/profile window: 280/351 s (79.8%) before the 26 MB profile completes.
chain.qualification: That window is not a raw-job execution timestamp; parsing alone was 2.353 s offline.

chain.step: cumulative profile and sealed layout question
chain.operation: streamed-profile, followed by a state-key intake-large job
chain.claimant: Singleton profile runner claims fenced attempt; consumes already published raw slots in order.
chain.fixedWaits: 1 s only when the next slot is absent; immediate continue on ready slots; 12 min wait ceiling.
chain.estimatedShare: Final empty-poll tail <=1 s plus dispatch handoff; most profiling overlaps the raw stream.
chain.qualification: Separate profile CPU/SQL share within ZIP's 543.78 s pre-layout is unknown.

chain.step: teacher branch versus streamed officer layout
chain.operation: intake-draft only for the bounded-file memory/teacher branch; none for streamed teacher work
chain.claimant: Bounded draft runner has one process slot, teacher lane two; streamed authoring is an API command.
chain.fixedWaits: Bounded proposal deadline 45 s, not a sleep; streamed authoring has no teacher wait.
chain.estimatedShare: Teacher contributes 0 s on the streamed ZIP/26 MB path; do not assign 45 s to these files.

chain.operation: Officer approval command queues intake-large, which enqueues chunk-mapping
chain.claimant: Approval validates sealed profile and current recipe; mapping later claims its own fenced job.
chain.fixedWaits: No approval debounce or lease sleep; two dispatcher handoffs, each nominally <=750 ms idle.
chain.estimatedShare: 26 MB profile-done to layout is 140.7 s (28.6% of pre-layout); human/queue/UI split unknown.

chain.step: chunk mapping and global source-key closure
chain.claimant: One fenced mapping runner per dispatcher; table lane two, contract active limit one.
chain.fixedWaits: 100 records/256 KiB per chunk, serial key writes; 1 s only if no next raw slot; retry 2 s.
chain.estimatedShare: Raw input is already sealed here, so empty-source polling should contribute 0 s.
chain.qualification: Mapping execution is an unknown portion of ZIP's 422.6 s post-approval, not 21 fixed waits.

chain.claimant: Fenced large runner; ordered cut/item/case locks, exact raw-byte and closed-key proofs.
chain.fixedWaits: No cut sleep; 60 s work slice, 30 s range-read and 60 s normalizer deadlines, not idle waits.

chain.claimant: Publishing transaction owns the package and item; Studio reads proposals, never grants authority.
chain.fixedWaits: SSE normally refreshes immediately; batch/area fallback 5 s; package tray poll 700 ms.
chain.estimatedShare: Nominal visible tail 0-5.7 s (<0.6% of ZIP total); REH14 stale-stream delays are unallocated.

chain.step: Act 1 confirmation to recorded building and verified card
chain.operation: intake-run commit, then prioritized target/evidence jobs
chain.claimant: Singleton run picks next ready non-leased job, LIMIT 1, then claims through the same authority.
chain.fixedWaits: 750 ms dispatch tick; retry 2 s; lease 180 s; targets and card stages intentionally ordered.
chain.estimatedShare: One 750 ms handoff is <0.6% of 129.574 s; 66.533 s to recorded is 51.3% of that time.
